title: Holy Bible - American Standard Version
author: Bible Channel
description: The American Standard Version (ASV) of the Bible, published in 1901, is a significant English translation of the Holy Scriptures. It emerged from the American revision of the English Revised Version of 1881–1885, which itself sought to improve upon the King James Version of 1611 through the use of more accurate manuscripts and careful biblical scholarship.The ASV is widely recognized for its faithfulness to the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek texts, its formal translation style, and its precise use of language. It preserves the dignity and solemnity of traditional biblical English while striving for greater accuracy and consistency. One of its distinctive features is the frequent use of the divine name “Jehovah” in the Old Testament.Divided into the Old and New Testaments, the ASV contains the foundational narratives, laws, prophecies, teachings, and accounts of Jesus Christ and the early Church. Its emphasis on textual accuracy has made it valuable for personal devotion, biblical study, preaching, and theological research.Although later translations have adopted more contemporary English, the American Standard Version remains an enduring resource for readers seeking a careful and reverent rendering of God's Word.

Different voices. Shared stories.Tune in to Connecting World as we bridge gaps, spark conversations, and build connections that make a difference.

title: Crooked Trees
author: Lauren Mohler, Host and Creator
description: Crooked Trees is a deeply researched, serialized, documentary true-crime series. Each season involves an extraordinary case and goes backward through the lives, places, relationships, and systems that shaped it. Season 1 follows brothers Shannon and Shauncey Box, whose story began in South Florida and ended at the center of a triple-homicide case in rural Georgia. Through original reporting, a childhood connection with the brothers, archival material, interviews, court and law-enforcement records, and on-location storytelling, Crooked Trees tells the immersive full story and nothing less.

title: Living In Motion
author: Anika Voy
description: Living in Motion - the podcast that moves body, mind and soul - explores what makes us feel alive and what it means to create a life that truly moves us - from the inside out. Hosted by Anika Voy, certified dance therapist and holistic psychotherapist, we dive into the many layers of being human - from relationships, motherhood and healing to desire, nervous system health & body wisdom to courage, creativity and purpose. title: The Manchurian Voter Podcast
author: Ma'Moo T. Redman
description: A companion podcast to The Manchurian Voter: Breaking the Trance, 10 Steps to Think for Yourself Again, by Ma'Moo T. Redman. Each episode covers one part of the book in about 8 to 10 minutes. Find the full series at mamoopublications.com.

title: The Robot Revolution
author: Saeed
description:
What happens when machines become strong enough to build our homes, intelligent enough to perform our jobs, and advanced enough to make decisions that once required human judgment? Welcome to The Robot Revolution, a three-part podcast exploring a future that is no longer confined to science fiction.

As robotics and artificial intelligence continue to advance, factories, hospitals, offices, warehouses, and even our homes are changing. Robots can perform repetitive tasks with remarkable consistency, while intelligent systems are increasingly capable of analyzing information, solving problems, and assisting with creative work. But this technological progress raises an unsettling question: if machines can do more of what humans do, what will be left for us?

Across three thought-provoking episodes, we investigate the rise of intelligent machines, examine the possibility of widespread job displacement, and explore whether humanity could lose its independence in a world dominated by automation. We also consider the opportunities robots may create, the importance of human creativity and empathy, and the responsibility of those who develop and control these technologies.

This is not simply a story about robots taking over. It is a story about power, survival, adaptation, and the future of human identity. The revolution is already underway. The real question is whether we will shape it—or allow it to shape us.

If you're tired of Googling every behavior, wondering if you're doing enough, or simply wishing you had someone who truly understands this life, you're in the right place. description:
Manifestation that starts with a regulated nervous system, not with louder affirmations.

Most advice about manifesting is surface level. You repeat that everything is fine while your body stays locked in a fight with reality. That is a defence mechanism, not a transformation.

Back to Self works in the other order. First you regulate your nervous system, so your body stops reading your desire as a threat. Then, from that settled place, you install the identity that no longer needs proof from the outside world.

Each episode covers one of three things: somatic work and the physiology of feeling safe, how to stop reacting emotionally to your circumstances, and the Law of Assumption taught the way Neville Goddard actually taught it.

Hosted by Bea Badura, coach and founder of MindShift Life, working with EFT, somatics and the Law of Assumption for six years.

title: Ongetemd - Met Sabine van der Hulst & Anne Quaars
author: ongetemd
description:
Twee vrouwen. Twee scherpe geesten. Eén vriendschap. Geen sociaal wenselijke gesprekken.

Wat gebeurt er als twee onafhankelijke denkers, die ook nog eens vriendinnen zijn, samen hardop gaan denken?

Sabine en Anne nemen je mee in de gesprekken die ze normaal gesproken met elkaar voeren. Ongeregisseerd, ongefilterd en zonder vooraf bepaalde bestemming. Alsof je bij ze in de kamer zit en stiekem mag meeluisteren.

Van liefde, relaties en menselijke psychologie tot ondernemerschap, macht, leiderschap en alles wat zich daartussen afspeelt.

Ze analyseren, filosoferen, lachen, dagen elkaar uit en stellen vragen waar anderen misschien liever omheen bewegen. Soms intellectueel en diepgaand, soms heerlijk ongenuanceerd, persoonlijk of ronduit hilarisch.

Niet om gelijk te krijgen, maar om samen verder te komen.

Geen interviews, geen ingestudeerde antwoorden en geen gesprekken die ergens naartoe moeten. Wel twee vriendinnen die elkaar scherp houden, hun eigen overtuigingen durven te onderzoeken en geen onderwerp uit de weg gaan.

Want de interessantste gesprekken ontstaan niet wanneer iedereen het eens is, maar wanneer je samen voorbij het vanzelfsprekende durft te kijken.

ONGETEMD. Vrij in denken. Scherp in woorden. Diep in gesprek.

author: Chinenye Uzondu. Podcast host, bible teacher and family physician.
description:
Are you an immigrant Christian woman living and working abroad? Have you found yourself feeling that there is more God has for you? Do you desire a more intimate walk with the Holy Spirit? Do you sometimes feel you are not connecting with God? 
I am delighted you are here.
This podcast will help you learn how to be in tune with God’s voice, develop a structure for consistency in your walk with God, and help you grow in serving Him.
Hey, I’m Chinenye, an unashamed Jesus lover, a wife, mum of three, a Nigerian British woman and a fully qualified GP.
I have lived outside of Nigeria for about 8 years now. I have struggled with my walk with God in a new environment while juggling childcare, parenting , marriage, finances and a career. I have had to deal with moments of low
self-esteem, fear, feeling inadequate and not being sure of what God has designed me for.
I have tried  leaning entirely on my own strength or my previous encounters with God especially while living in Nigeria. I found that I needed an active and ongoing walk with God. I found that I needed to understand who God has designed me as especially in this new environment He has planted me.
I found that learning to hear God in real time and follow His leading always brought me to a place of fulfilment and more growth.
On this podcast, you will learn more about growing in your relationship with God, finding your identity in Him and walking in your God-given purpose.
If you are ready to go on the same journey, make yourself comfortable and let’s dive in.

title: Beyond Protest: The Proposal
author: baradellopublishing@proton.me
description:
In recent years, major cities like Paris, Milan, and Turin have become the stage for mounting tensions, social unrest, and incidents of youth violence. The standard response often involves emergency measures or the militarization of urban spaces—interventions that merely treat the symptoms without addressing the root causes of the problem.
This podcast aims to shift the focus from the superficial to the profound. Through rigorous, systemic analysis, the narrator guides the listener beyond mere headlines and the rhetoric of fear, exploring the true triggers of urban malaise: from spatial segregation and economic precariousness to identity crises and emotional isolation.
Each episode is rooted in the concrete realities of these three cities, offering practical, innovative, and effective solutions designed to:
Rebuild the fabric of trust between citizens and institutions.
Restore dignity and opportunity to the suburbs and to younger generations.
Transform the urban environment into a safe, peaceful, and prosperous ecosystem where every individual can flourish.

Hawa Horzela, die Leitung der Musikkindertgärten, spricht darüber, wie Lieder, Rhythmus und Rituale den Familien- und Kita-Alltag leichter, fröhlicher und verbundener machen. 

Freut euch auf persönliche Erfahrungen von Hawa, praktische Impulse zum direkten Ausprobieren und echte Einblicke hinter die Kulissen eines Musikkindergartens.

Ob beim Autofahren, auf dem Spielplatz oder in der Mittagspause: Hört rein, schaut zu und lasst euch inspirieren. 

Schön, dass ihr dabei seid!

Each episode shares useful insights and actionable ideas to help entrepreneurs and small-business owners overcome challenges, make better decisions, and build sustainable businesses.

Whether you're starting a new business or looking to improve an existing one, you'll find ideas and lessons to help you move forward with confidence.

description: Rise & Mavs, hosted by Kevin Gray of DLLS Sports & Mavericks Beat Writer for The Athletic Christian Clark, is your three times a week Mavs morning show that discusses the biggest topics, storylines, and things happening in and around the Dallas Mavericks! Every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday morning at 9:30 AM CST, KG & Christian bring you your Mavs morning primer breaking down the games, discussing the Mavericks biggest stars, including Cooper Flagg, Kyrie Irving, P.J. Washington and the latest news and notes on the team! Plus, the guys answer your questions and comments in a fast-paced 30-minute show also available live on YouTube on Gray's YouTube Channel KevinGraySports!

title: Press Play By Culture's Biggest
author: Culture's Biggest
description:
Press Play by Culture’s Biggest is where the album gets the room it deserves.
Every episode starts the same way: we press play. The record runs in full, with the artist or producers in the room, and we stop to talk about what we just heard. How a beat was built. Why a verse landed the way it did. What the title means, who’s on the cover, and how the whole project came together.
It’s a sit-down for listeners who care about the music itself, and for artists who want to talk about their work without the noise. No controversy, no clickbait, no hot takes.
New episodes drop around major releases.

title: Beyond The Envelope
author: Cxnch
description: Beyond the Envelope helps small and mid-sized businesses uncover what their mail really costs and how to send it smarter, from postage and certified mail to security, compliance and the tools big companies have used for years. Hosted by father and son Kevin and Steve Diamond, who bring 70 years of combined mail-industry experience, with new episodes every Tuesday.

title: Island Idylls
author: Aaron Menikoff
description: Island Idylls riffs on books and life with Barry Menikoff. Author of Stone Mother, Brooklyn born and bred, retired Hawaii university professor, international scholar. Evangelical pastor Aaron Menikoff, author of Politics and Piety, spices this dialogue between father and son. Both chasing that elusive line in an old song, What's it all about, Alfie?

title: Life Between Breaths
author: Zipporah Robinson
description:
Life Between Breaths is an audio storytelling series that brings respiratory health to life through relatable stories, everyday moments, and the people behind every breath. Each episode blends family, emotion, education, and real-life inspired situations—creating stories that entertain, connect, and leave you with something to think about.
A Global Respiratory Wellness Studios Original.
Every breath has a story. Every story brings hope.

title: Breaking Down the Buzz
author: The State Hornet
description: A news-talk show where we discuss all things relevant to SacState and its surrounding community.

title: Bounce Over The Touchline
author: Lewis Stafford
description:
Welcome to Bounce Over the Touchline! ⚽
A football podcast exploring the people, journeys and experiences that shape the game.
From grassroots to the professional game, we sit down with coaches and people across football to share stories, perspectives and lessons learned along the way.
Hosted by Lewis Stafford, with conversations that go beyond what happens on the pitch.

title: Rogue Reels
author: Raven Artworx
description: Rogue Reels is where EDC, knives, and the people behind them collide. Hosted by Sam (Raven the Pirate) and Rikki (Captain Rikki), we talk knives, gear, industry drama, creative work, and the personalities shaping the EDC community. Expect honest conversations, strong opinions, behind-the-scenes stories, and plenty of yapping. No corporate BS — just good people, sharp gear, and unfiltered talk.

title: Sinister Hellfire
author: Rose Sinister, Tsarina Hellfire
description: Hosted by Rose Sinister and Tsarina Hellfire, Sinister Hellfire is your ultimate guide to the vibrant, diverse vampire culture of New Orleans. From the history of the occult and local folklore to the modern goth scene, burlesque, and pop culture, we explore why the Crescent City is the true home for creatures of the night.

title: Built Well Podcast
author: Jose Lopez
description:
Every business has a highlight reel. This show is about everything that got cut.
On Built Well, Jose Lopez sits down with founders, coaches and operators for honest conversations about how their businesses really got built: the pivots, the burnout, the bets that almost broke them, and the moments it all clicked. Along the way, you’ll hear how smart owners are using AI to work better without losing the human touch.
Real stories. Lessons you can use Monday morning.
Founder stories. Honest conversations. Smarter businesses.

title: Dads 'n Dragons
author: DadsnDragons
description:
What happens when a 45-year-old who grew up on role-playing games sits down to play with his kids? Welcome to Dads 'n Dragons, a live-play D&D podcast in the world of Ravnica and Theros. I’ve always wanted to share this hobby with my kids, and when the time came I thought it would be easy! I was wrong. In Dads ’n Dragons you’ll hear unique takes on role-playing, on problem solving, and dumb jokes that you can’t get anywhere else.

Follow the gang on Twitter @dadsndragons for the latest updates!

title: Change Your Filter
author: Contractor Commerce
description:
Change Your Filter is the home service industry’s leading resource for education, insight, and entertainment.

If you're a home service contractor looking for inspiration, perspective, and insights from fellow contractors and trade professionals, this podcast is for you. Subscribe to the Change Your Filter podcast and meet everyday people as they share their stories. 

Change your perspective. Change your point of view. Change your attitude. Change your trajectory. Change Your Filter. 

Powered by https://www.contractorcommerce.com/

title: InvestBetter.™ Podcast
author: InvestBetter.™
description: The InvestBetter.™ Podcast is all about calling out the limitations of the industry while calling you — our listeners — up to something better. Real investing & financial planning is not about mutual funds and stocks, and insurance. It’s proactive, strategic, and creative. Investing better doesn’t have to be put off to the future. It can start today.

title: Connected Commerce
author: Hai Mag
description: Connected Commerce is the podcast by Eva Commerce, featuring conversations with ecommerce leaders, Amazon experts, founders, and industry professionals sharing actionable insights to help brands grow.

author: Peter Bryant
description:
Woolgathering (noun): idle daydreaming
This is a show about how we spend our downtime. We're not interested in maximising our productivity; we want to slow down and enjoy a good book, a great film, or some time outside.

description: David's Audio Lab is the discussion of comedy, satire, and other recording pieces that the host created for listening, covering the ideas of fake commercial parodies, sketches, comedy pieces, instrumentals, fake news stores, fake history and other stuff that the host makes up for entertainment.

title: Found In Translation
author: Haoyang Zhang; Noa Perloff
description:
Welcome to Found in Translation, a podcast about friendship, curiosity, and seeing the world from two different perspectives.
We're two good friends—one American, one Chinese—who grew up in very different cultures but share a curiosity about pretty much everything. From movies and relationships to everyday life, cultural differences, and whatever random topics catch our attention, we explore what makes our perspectives different, surprisingly similar, and sometimes hilarious.
Two friends. Two cultures. No shortage of things to talk about.

title: The Busy Dad Rebuild
author: Derek Schell
description:
The Busy Dad Rebuild is a podcast for busy dads over 40 who are tired of feeling soft, drained, and stuck starting over every Monday.

I’m Derek Schell, founder of Minimalist Gym Coaching, NASM-certified trainer, and NCI-certified nutrition coach. Each week I break down how to lose fat, build muscle, and get your energy back without making fitness your entire life. You won’t hear about extreme diets, 90-minute workouts, or the latest “big secret.” This show is about the basics that move the needle and a system that holds up when life gets crazy.

What we cover:

  • Simple, protein-forward nutrition
  • Efficient 30–45 minute workouts, at home or in the gym
  • Fat loss that lasts
  • Training like an athlete after 40
  • Building habits that survive busy weeks, travel, and setbacks
  • Sleep, stress, and recovery
  • Leading by example for your family
  • And some fun stuff along the way

You’ve spent years putting everyone else first. Taking care of yourself isn’t selfish. It’s part of being a husband, father, and provider.

Let’s get to work.

title: Everyday Learning Studio
author: Tony Guys
description: A calm, practical podcast about everyday learning, digital awareness, and smart decision-making. Each episode explains one useful topic in simple language, with a focus on clarity, safety, and responsible online behavior.

title: Management Café
author: Pilar Orti
description:
Season 4: Join co-hosts Tim Burgess and Pilar Orti as they chat about what they've learned through their time leading teams. 
Season 3: Oh No, My Team's Gone Remote! 
Seasons 1 and 2: Improve your management and leadership practice over a cup of coffee and get a book recommendation too. 
The role of the manager is evolving as technology helps us to self-organise and take more control of how and where we work from. In this podcast, Pilar Orti from Virtual not Distant, dissects modern management practice, not just for official managers, but for team members who want to make things happen too.

title: Canfluencer
author: CTV News
description:
They’ve built massive audiences, sparked conversations, and inspired millions of Canadians. Canfluencer is an exclusive CTV News series that takes you behind the scenes with Canada’s biggest social media stars, uncovering the stories, passions, and purpose behind their influence.
 
Subscribe to the CTV News YouTube channel for full Canfluencer video podcasts, exclusive interviews, and first access to every new release, then catch the series across CTV National News, CTV News Channel, CTVNews.ca, and Crave.

title: The Fruited Fig: Rooted in Wisdom
author: Aimee Evans
description:
What's more important: living life to it's fullest or living a life of wisdom? By listening to The Fruited Fig: Rooted in Wisdom, you can have both: a fulfilled life rooted in Biblical wisdom. Join me, Aimee, owner of The Fruited Fig Academy on a jouney where teens and adults can grow in Biblical Wisdom. 

In additon to this podcast, we have hosted virtual events including Social Saturdays - Bible Bingo and Fruited Fig Book Night (bookclub discussion). These kick off January 2027. Study guides for this podcast are available on The Fruited Fig's Academy Classroom Resources for teachers and listeners wanting to get more out of today's discussion and are tailored for multiple ages; from teens on up. 

About me: Teacher, Developmental Therapist and student of Biblical Wisdom, I founded The Fruited Fig Academy in 2026 to combine my love of all three. I have degrees in Special Education, Developmental Therapy / Child Development, Religious Education, Biblical Counseling, and Divinity. 

I want to make this podcast to all and as Jesus said "to the least of my brothers". With that said, I welcome all as you welcome me. I do have a hard time speaking sometimes, but try my best and with your support, take that as a way to continue my outreach.

title: Rank Doesn't Lead
author: Keith Clicque
description: Rank is earned. Leadership is demonstrated. Rank Doesn't Lead turns real-world events into practical leadership lessons. Host Keith Clicque, a police chief in North Texas, looks at leaders with rank and at the people who lead without a title: the dispatcher, the veteran officer, the nurse, the teammate everyone turns to. In five minutes or less, three times a week, you'll get lessons on accountability, culture, crisis, and trust from a chief who's still learning the job too. It's for public safety professionals and anyone responsible for leading others.

title: ¿What if your future isn't written yet?

description:
🎙️ Unwritten Futures: The Road Ahead – Episode: Planning Our Next Chapter
What will your life look like in the next few years? In this episode, Yineidy and Manuela open up about their personal, academic, and professional goals, from finishing their studies and exploring scholarships or online certifications, to building careers in project management, sustainability, and digital marketing.
Along the way, they talk about moving into a first apartment, traveling to Japan, building healthier habits, and why it’s okay to stay flexible when circumstances change. Whether your plans are set in stone or still uncertain, this conversation is a reminder that the road ahead is full of possibilities.
☕ Grab a cup of coffee and join us as we explore our unwritten futures!
📌 Follow the show, leave your comments, and tell us: what’s on your road ahead?
🗓️ New episodes every week!
#UnwrittenFutures #TheRoadAhead #Goals #FuturePlanning #PersonalGrowth #CareerGoals #Podcast

title: How AI Is Changing Everyday Life
author: Taus Tinila
description:
Artificial Intelligence is becoming a part of everyday life, transforming how we work, learn, communicate, and solve problems. In this episode, we explore how AI tools are changing modern workplaces, helping people automate repetitive tasks, improve productivity, and discover new creative possibilities.We also discuss the challenges of AI, including data privacy, responsible use, misinformation, and the importance of human judgment.

Whether you're a student, professional, entrepreneur, or simply curious about emerging technology, this episode offers an accessible introduction to the opportunities and limitations of artificial intelligence.Tune in to discover practical ways AI is shaping our future and why understanding this technology matters more than ever.

Topics covered: Artificial intelligence, AI automation, productivity tools, future technology, digital skills, responsible AI, and everyday innovation.

author: Storied
description: Storied is the home for arts and humanities shows from PBS Digital Studios. Subscribe to explore art, culture, mythology and much more! Otherwords: Hosted by sociolinguist Erica Brozovsky, Ph.D., this show digs deep into this quintessential human trait of language.

title: My Family are Haunted
author: Rehannah Mian
description:
That's me in the red dress, standing outside our family home in Nottingham in  1977.  What happened inside that house has stayed with me for nearly fifty years.


Every family has its ghosts. These are mine.

I was too young to understand everything that was happening in that house, but it was terrifying, and when we left I believe that something followed us.  Decades later, I'm ready to tell my story. 


This Christmas Eve, I'm sharing the first chapter.

My Family Are Haunted.

A true family story about the things I experienced but still can't explain.


🎧 Trailer available now on Spotify, Apple Podcasts and YouTube.

My Family are Haunted launches 24th Dec 2026. 


True ghost stories | Supernatural | Real haunted houses | Ghosts

title: The Digital Menu — Conversations Shaping Our Digital Future
author: Hon Minister Tatenda Mavetera
description:
Welcome to The Digital Menu, a podcast exploring how technology, innovation, and digital transformation are reshaping Zimbabwe and the world.
Hosted by Hon. Tatenda Mavetera, Minister of Information Communication Technology, Postal and Courier Services (ICTPCS), the podcast brings together industry leaders, innovators, policymakers, and changemakers to discuss the ideas, technologies, and solutions shaping our digital future.

title: Stealing Elections, American Style
author: David F. Walbert
description:
160 years of stolen elections. This is the story of the past, present, and future of democracy in America.
We explore our country's history to better understand the biggest challenges facing our democracy today. Gerrymandering, voter suppression, ballot stuffing, and straight up stolen elections. 
Hosted by David F. Walbert (Constitutional and Voting Rights Litigator & Author) & Anoa Changa-Peck (Journalist & Former Lawyer)
The book 'Stealing Elections, American Style' by David F. Walbert was published in Sept 2026 by Bloomsbury.

title: The Adventures of Prickly Porky (A Mystery in Green Meadows)
author: Thornton W. Burgess
description:
When Prickly Porky the Porcupine discovers a mysterious creature roaming the hill, the entire animal community is thrown into a frenzy. What could this odd being be, with no head, no legs, and no tail? As word spreads, everyone from Peter Rabbit to Reddy Fox and even the wise Buster Bear shares their wild theories, each more fantastical than the last. Join this captivating adventure through the Green Meadows as Prickly Porky embarks on a quest to uncover the truth behind the enigma that has everyone guessing.

In "Adventures of Prickly Porky," listeners will dive into a delightful tale filled with humor, friendship, and the thrill of discovery. Each character brings their unique perspective, creating a rich tapestry of ideas and experiences. As the mystery unfolds, young listeners will learn valuable lessons about curiosity, teamwork, and the importance of understanding one another. With vivid descriptions and charming dialogue, Thornton W. Burgess weaves a story that sparks imagination and encourages critical thinking.

Will Prickly Porky and his friends solve the mystery before fear takes hold? Tune in to join the fun and find out! This audiobook is perfect for bedtime listening or car rides, sure to entertain and engage children of all ages while igniting their sense of wonder.

title: Christ's High Priestly Prayer
author: Westminster Seminary California
description: In the final hours before His arrest, Jesus prayed one of the most profound prayers in all of Scripture — a prayer for His own glory, for His disciples, and for every believer who would come after them. Christ's High Priestly Prayer is a weekly, verse-by-verse journey through John 17, hosted by Dr. A. Craig Troxel, Professor of Practical Theology at Westminster Seminary California. Each episode slows down to sit with the text — tracing what it means for the Father to glorify the Son, what it means for Christ to reveal God's name and character, and what it means for believers to be kept.

description: The RealPower Radio Show with Kenn Dowell and Dr. Heather E. Burton, live every Tuesday 12 to 1 PM on WOVU 95.9 FM in Cleveland. The Gray Agenda, hosted by Luke and Ian Gray, dives into the grittier, often unspoken realities of transition, explores the wonderfully diverse experiences of the alphabet mafia, and unpacks the latest news shaping the LGBTQ+ community.
From identity, relationships, and mental health to culture, controversy, and the everyday absurdities of being human, no topic is off the table.

From malevolent entities and lost footage to real life disappearances, mind bending conspiracies, and cases that were never supposed to be solved. Some stories are pulled from fiction - monsters that defy science, creatures that bend reality, digital anomalies that infect more than just machines. Others are ripped straight from the real world - unexplainable events, haunted transmissions, and encounters that left behind no trace...

Join DNA and Epigenetics Coach Robin Shatz for easy-to-understand connections between your body and everyday life, with a little humor, and simple shifts that support lasting change.

description: Trinity Reformed Church is an embassy of the kingdom of God in Tucson, Arizona. We are equipping people to be fully human for the glory of God through the means of preaching, teaching, community building, and receiving grace in our time of need each week in the Lord’s Supper.

title: The Unlikely
author: The Unlikely
description:
True stories that sound impossible, and real what-ifs followed to their strangest end.
The Unlikely explores the moments where history almost went differently, the survivors who beat impossible odds, and the hidden science behind the world around us. From the man who survived both atomic bombs to the deal that turned New Amsterdam into New York, every episode is researched, fact-checked and told as a story.
New episodes every week. Watch or listen, whichever suits you.

title: Enliven Chapters with Avi Patel
author: Avi Patel
description:
ENLIVEN Chapters is a podcast built around that very idea: to enliven the way people think, grow, and live.
ENLIVEN means to bring life, energy, and light into something.
Our host, Mr. Avi Patel, sits across from each guest with one intention: to learn from their journey and turn those experiences into conversations that can help someone else level up in life.
One guest. One story. One conversation at a time.

author: Collyn Nielsen
description: Join Doc and his guests on Hiker Trash Radio, the outdoor adventure podcast that takes you on a myriad of trails. With interviews from thru hikers, skydivers, adventure athletes, big wall climbers, and more, each episode is packed with trail talk, gear tips, and hilarious misadventures. And if you thought the great outdoors was all sunshine and rainbows, think again! Tune in for tales of blistered feet, helicopter evacuations, and Type II Fun that will make you appreciate the comforts of home. Settle in and get ready to trade the city for the wilderness. It's time to embrace the suck!

title: Diary of an immigrant
author: chukwunonso arinze
description:
Every immigrant carries a story they rarely get to tell. Diary of an Immigrant is where those stories finally get heard. Host Victor Arinze sits down with people who left everything behind to start over in Canada: the nurses, students, dreamers and builders shaping this country from the GTA to coast to coast. These are raw, honest conversations about the sacrifices, the loneliness, the setbacks, and the victories nobody posts about. Whether you're an immigrant, the child of one, or someone who wants to understand the journey, you'll find a piece of yourself here. Real people. Real journeys. No filter.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

Join Peter Szpakowski, an independent travel agent affiliated with Atlas Coast Travel Group, as he shares over 30 years of personal cruising experience, practical advice, and the ways he uses AI to research and plan travel.
Whether you're preparing for your first cruise or your next adventure, discover tips on choosing ships and cabins, comparing deals, evaluating drink packages, planning shore excursions, and packing useful travel gear. Conversations that move the skilled trades forward.


The skilled trades are changing fast, and staying ahead requires more than just hard work—it takes smart strategy, modern systems, and continuous growth.


Contractor World Land is the podcast dedicated to elevating the construction and trade industry through authentic, high-value conversations. Each week, we bring you inside the minds of residential and commercial contractors, specialty trade leaders, and industry innovators who are actively redefining what success looks like on and off the job site.


Whether we’re discussing:

  • Business & Scale: Moving from solo operator to structured crew management
  • Financial Mastery: Estimating, margins, overhead, and protecting your bottom line
  • Modern Workflows: Implementing AI, job site tech, and lean operations
  • Industry Mindset: Overcoming trade hurdles, hiring top talent, and building a legacy


...you’ll walk away with real-world takeaways you can apply directly to your business.


Tune in every week wherever you listen to podcasts. 


Let’s build better, scale smarter, and move the trades forward together.

title: The Succession Conversation

description:
Most advice about succession stops at the structure. The harder part is the conversation that decides who leads next, and making sure they're ready when the time comes.

Whether you advise family businesses or you're the founder deciding who leads next, this is where you learn what it actually takes.

Vantage founding partner Carl Robinson and partner Susan Ko, head of the firm's family enterprise practice, have spent decades in the rooms with family enterprises.

Each episode starts with a problem most families don't see coming, then gets into how Vantage works through it, what's worked, what hasn't, and what it really took.

When it's time for your family to hand things over, this is where you get ready.

title: Remind Us Again
author: Remind Us Again
description:
Remind Us Again helps people understand how God works in all of life so they can remember Who He is, especially when their circumstances make that difficult.


Through clear, biblical teaching, founder and teacher Jay Hohfeler connects Scripture with the historical context that brings it to life. Using maps, timelines, cross-references, and other teaching tools, each episode explores the people, places, and circumstances of the biblical text while revealing enduring truths about God and people.


Drawing from Scripture and his own experience trusting God through profound hardship, including terminal cancer, Jay teaches a foundational truth: Trust in God does not depend on favorable circumstances.


Remind Us Again is designed to do more than inform or encourage. It helps us interpret our lives through what is true about God.


Because when we understand how God works, we are better prepared to remember Who He is.

title: The Brain Docs
author: The Brain Docs
description: Brain health for you, your family, and your community with Drs. Dean and Ayesha Sherzai, a unique husband-and-wife team on the cutting edge of brain science. Drs. Sherzai are dedicated to educating people on the simple steps to long-term health and wellness through their work as neurologists, scientists and public health advocates through online writing, videos, and books. There is a tsunami of diseases of the brain such as Alzheimer’s, stroke and Parkinson’s disease permeating our culture. In our own communities and families, we all have known at least one person suffering from these illnesses and in many cases seen the fallout first-hand. There is no treatment for these diseases, and the emotional, financial and social burden is immense, and at this point, lifestyle interventions are the best solution for reducing dementia risk

title: Between Worlds with Andréa and Brian

description:
A psychic medium and a skeptic walk into the unexplained. Andréa Kohalmi Summers senses what others can’t. Brian Edwards trusts what he can prove. Together, they share true paranormal experiences that left them questioning their beliefs.
Between Worlds explores ghost stories, spiritual encounters, intuition, energy, and more, along with the moments that turn out to have an explanation hiding in plain sight. Not everything that goes bump in the night is supernatural, and sometimes there’s more to what we see with our own eyes.
Believer, skeptic, or curious, join us Between Worlds.

title: Crafting Exile
author: BCB Studios
description: Crafting Exile explores different, and often under-investigated, dimensions of life in exile, as experienced by Chilean exiles in the UK.  The podcast builds on previous research, which included the film and exhibition Crafting Resistance: The Art of Ex-Political Prisoners. Emerging themes included the intergenerational transmission of memory, alongside questions of legacy, transnational culture and identity. The podcast series picks up on these themes, exploring them through the experiences and perspectives of those living in exile.  Ultimately, Crafting Exile aims to deepen our understanding of the experience of exile and consider how the knowledge and perspectives of those who have lived through it can contribute to building more socially just societies.

Through genuine conversation, Candour Conversations gives families an opportunity to get to know the people behind Candour Funerals.

I'm a dad of three boys, and I cook almost everything we eat from scratch. Dadz Cooking is the real kitchen: the wins, the hassles, the sourdough, and the simple habits that make healthy food quick and easy.
Cooking isn't a chore to squeeze in after everything else. It's the foundation of your physical, mental and emotional well-being, and it deserves a place ahead of the scrolling and the Friday nights out.

author: The Creative Enterprise
description:
The future of work won’t be built on efficiency alone. It will be built on human creativity.
Hosted by award-winning psychologist, author and Artgym Founder and CEO Dr. Eugene Hughes, The Creative Enterprise brings together pioneering leaders and thinkers to explore how organisations can unlock collective creativity at scale. 
Through candid conversations on leadership, culture, human behaviour, AI and the future of work, discover what it takes to build organisations where people, and their creativity, can thrive.

title: Booked and Plated with Amy Ogden
author: Amy Ogden
description:
Your food is incredible. Your events run like clockwork. So why aren’t you booked out?

On Booked & Plated, chef turned web designer Amy Ogden helps independent caterers see that getting booked isn't a ‘you’ problem, it's a ‘systems’ problem.

After 25 years in the culinary field, Amy knows you already trust systems with everything from prep lists to pre-event checks. Your website should work the same way. A pretty site isn't enough. You need something sustainable that's constantly working in the background to keep new clients coming in.

In quick 3 to 5 minute episodes every Monday and Tuesday, Amy breaks down the barriers that might be costing you clients, the bad advice keeping you stuck, and what the most-booked caterers have working behind the scenes.

No jargon, no lectures, just back of the house talk with someone who has been on both sides of the pass and both sides of the screen. The rush is over, flip over a milk crate and let's chat; or book a tour at bookedandplated.com to learn how this done-for-you website system goes live one week from your build date.

title: Proyekto Pilipino: Conversations on Civics and Politics
author: Proyekto Pilipino and Podcast Network Asia
description:
Proyekto Pilipino is a podcast about Filipino history, culture, and civics made for the Filipino people. The goal is to hold discussions about historical events and current issues to build a culture of valuing and understanding. 
In preparation for the May 2022 elections, season 1 will focus on highlighting the importance of Civics in our voting and electoral process. 
Join Fr. Tito Caluag and three distinguished historians and thinkers—Dr. Leloy Claudio, Manolo Quezon III, and Carlo Santiago—as we refresh our knowledge of our rights and obligations as citizens, dive deeper into the processes and roles of the government, and understand the importance of taking part in the democratic project of the Philippines. 
The goal: so we can make better and informed decisions for our country.
New episodes drop Mondays and Thursdays, brought to you by The Conscience Collective and Podcast Network Asia.
 Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Mind Is A Man's Best Friend
author: Alex Serjeant
description:
"Mind Is A Man's Best Friend" is a male mental health podcast that shines a spotlight on men's emotional well-being. Through insightful interviews with diverse male guests, the show delves into their personal journeys, struggles, and triumphs in navigating the complex landscape of mental health. Join us as we foster a supportive, open dialogue around the minds of men, highlighting their unique experiences and emphasizing the importance of mental health for everyone.
The podcast is hosted by Alex Serjeant who currently facilitates a men's only mental health support group based in Bristol.

title: I Have Never Tasted a Tomato
author: Holger Nauheimer
description:
What happens when artificial intelligence enters the kitchen?
AI knows millions of recipes, but it has never tasted a tomato. And yet, it might change the way we cook.
Can a machine that has never smelled fresh basil, tasted a perfectly ripe peach, or burned its fingers on a hot pan help us become more creative cooks? Can AI invent genuinely new dishes, or does it simply rearrange what humans have already discovered? And what happens to culinary traditions, intuition, and the pleasure of cooking when artificial intelligence becomes part of the creative process?
I Have Never Tasted a Tomato explores these questions through conversations with chefs, food writers, researchers, sensory scientists, and people who are experimenting with AI in real kitchens.
Hosted by Holger Nauheimer, the podcast moves between the science of flavour, the art of cooking, and the deeply personal experiences that shape our relationship with food. Childhood memories, family recipes, spectacular failures, unexpected discoveries, and the dishes we never forget are just as important as algorithms and artificial intelligence.
A podcast about AI and cooking. But above all, about being human.

title: Seat to Street - Carlisle Diocese

Through open conversations and local stories, we explore what it means to live out faith beyond church walls — caring deeply, treading gently, speaking boldly, and following daily.

description:
What does it really take to help people succeed?

You know the moment. The engagement numbers come back lower than last year, or your best person hands in their notice, and you realize the old playbook isn't working. Maybe you set the people strategy for the whole company. Maybe you manage a team of six and nobody ever trained you for it. Either way, you're the one people look to when work gets hard.

Join Robin Daniels and Nina Elisabeth Carøe as they go on a quest to find answers through candid conversations with leaders, researchers and people who've done remarkable things, from running AI companies to competing at the Olympics. Success is about more than what we achieve at work. It's about how we grow, lead, learn and live along the way.

So we'll leave you with the same question we ask our guests: What does human success mean to you?

Produced by Zensai.

What exactly is karma? Is everything that happens to us a result of our past actions? Why do bad things happen to good people? And can we change the consequences of our past mistakes?
Together, we explore how our intentions shape our lives, why karma is so unpredictable, and what the Buddha actually taught about our

title: YogaScussion: Yoga Talk, Culture, Philosophy & Practice
author: Brendon Orr
description:
Welcome to YogaScussion—the premier yoga podcast that goes beyond the mat. Hosted by Gina Clingerman and Brendon Orr, this weekly yoga talk show dives deep into yoga practice, yoga culture, and yoga philosophy with the teachers, healers, writers, and movers who are living it.

This isn't a yoga podcast about perfect poses or performative wellness. It's a conversation about what yoga actually looks like in real life—the injuries, the doubt, the breakthroughs, the joy, and the messy, beautiful middle. We explore how ancient wisdom meets modern life, how a dedicated yoga practice transforms off the mat, and what it means to build community in a world that's forgotten how to connect.

Each episode features honest, in-depth conversations with Gina, Brendon, and guests who bring diverse perspectives—from Ayurvedic physicians and somatic therapists to authors, yoga acharyas, yoga teachers, studio owners, and practitioners. Whether it's a yoga talk about the eight limbs, the yamas and niyamas, the business of yoga, the shifting landscape of modern yoga culture, or the neuroscience of stillness, we cover it all.

Whether you're a yoga teacher looking for depth, a practitioner seeking community, or someone who's curious about what yoga really is beyond the Instagram aesthetic—YogaScussion is your seat.

Follow, subscribe and join the YogaScussion.

Khan Academy provides teachers with data on how their students are doing so they can identify gaps in learning and provide tailored instruction. We also offer free personalized SAT and LSAT practice in partnership with the College Board and the Law School Admission Council.

Our resources have been translated into dozens of languages, and 15 million people around the globe learn on Khan Academy each month.

Want to extend your learning beyond YouTube? Practice what you've just discovered for free: www.khanacademy.org

title: The Patching Protocol
author: Alan Patching PhD
description:
Practical, evidence-informed insights into resilience, stress, anxiety and mental health.

The Patching Protocol is an audio podcast designed to help people understand, prevent and manage the effects of stress and anxiety, and to support those experiencing their psychological impacts in finding effective pathways towards recovery.

Drawing on clinical psychotherapy, counselling and hypnotherapy, each episode explores stress and anxiety in an accessible, practical way. The aim is not only to provide useful strategies for managing these experiences, but also to demystify mental health and address some of the concerns and misconceptions that can prevent people from seeking professional help when they need it.

Episodes examine the particular challenges that arise in different circumstances, including preparing for surgery and recovering afterwards, and coping with a troubling medical diagnosis or demanding treatment, such as that associated with cancer.

The podcast also explores two specialist areas of practice. The first is psychological support for women who have experienced repeated IVF failures despite having no identified physical explanation for those outcomes. This work considers the potential role of stress and psychological wellbeing in the IVF experience, and how therapeutic support may help women navigate what can be an emotionally demanding journey.

The second specialist area is workplace mental health, with a particular focus on psychosocial hazards and risks. Drawing on clinical practice, academic research and professional experience, the podcast examines how workplace environments, leadership behaviours, organisational cultures and the way work is managed can affect psychological health. It also considers how individuals and organisations can recognise and address psychosocial hazards, reduce the risks associated with harmful workplace conditions, and create healthier, more psychologically sustainable working environments.

Whether you are seeking to understand your own experiences, support someone close to you, or gain a deeper understanding of the factors affecting mental health at work, The Patching Protocol offers thoughtful, practical insights into the challenges we face and the ways we can respond to them.

Hosted by Dr Alan Patching, PhD, a clinical psychotherapist and hypnotherapist, The Patching Protocol draws on clinical experience, academic research and professional practice to explore the challenges of stress, anxiety and psychological wellbeing, offering evidence-informed perspectives on how we can better manage these challenges in our personal lives and workplaces.

description: Join Lily and Mia as they explore everything about China — its history, cities, people, culture, food, technology, and the ideas that shaped one of the oldest civilizations on Earth. One topic per episode, stories first, no lectures. New episodes every Sunday.
